title: Sunflower Conjecture
exact_target: For a fixed number of petals, does an exponential number of distinct equally sized sets always force a sunflower?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1324 (COMB-006). CC BY 4.0.
Ryan Alweiss, Shachar Lovett, Kewen Wu and Jiapeng Zhang, \emph{Improved bounds for the sunflower lemma}, arXiv:1908.08483v3 (2021), Definition 1.1 and Conjecture 1.3.
